features.title: Onboarding Welcome Tooltips
features.desired_outcome: Display clear introductory text prompts at the start of the first session explaining how to move and fight.
features.reason: Currently, a new player drops straight into a route with zero guidance.

features.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
features.desired_outcome: Add an in-game collection journal menu tracking route discovery milestones and cosmetic checklists.
features.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

features.title: Elite Enemy Aggression Modifiers
features.desired_outcome: Add dynamic combat encounter modifiers and pack configurations to raise the mastery ceiling.
features.reason: High-difficulty paths currently lack mechanical pressure and density, leading to passive traversal rather than tactical combat.

features.title: Weekend Route Coin Multiplier Content Pack
features.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary content modifier that grants a +10 coin bonus on alternate completion paths to accelerate elite item acquisition.
features.reason: Players saving toward elite cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown experience a sharp drop-off in purchasing power after buying two mid-tier items.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Focus Indicators
features.desired_outcome: Add distinct visual highlighting and focus rings to marketplace items, route selectors, and buttons.
features.reason: Clear focus states reduce cognitive load and navigation errors for accessibility-focused users.

features.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
features.desired_outcome: Input handling gracefully ignores redundant walk commands against blocking terrain or provides immediate contextual feedback.
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.

features.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
features.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
features.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

policy.note: AI beta-test recommendations are advisory. The owner manually implements changes with ChatGPT and uses Development Review only to monitor status.
